gaps.explanation: p5 Statement of Revenues, Expenditures, and Changes in Fund Balances - Modified Cash Basis - Governmental Funds prints General Fund 389,112, Street Fund 106,428 and CDBG Fund 560 total revenues (Total 496,100). detail[] holds only the General Fund departments schedule (p10, 389,112); the Street Fund and CDBG Fund columns have no schedule (the p9 budgetary schedule is all funds combined). Street Fund: Property 44,478 + Motor vehicle tax 3,624 + Sales tax 10,105 + Intergovernmental 47,828 + Licenses and permits 30 + Miscellaneous income 363 = 106,428; CDBG Fund: Loan collections 560. 389,112 + 106,428 + 560 = 496,100 = statement total.
